semiconductor_relevance: High — Carten Controls Ltd. manufactures ultra-high purity components and equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Carten Controls Ltd. specializes in ultra-high purity (UHP) and high-performance components and equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include bespoke equipment designed for contamination-free transportation and automated mixing of media, ensuring clean and efficient operations in semiconductor facilities.
capabilities: Ultra-high purity gas and liquid delivery systems
Automated mixing systems for semiconductor processes
Custom containment solutions for media transport

regional_presence.United States: Carten was founded in Connecticut and has expanded its operations with a site in Waterford, contributing to its growth in core industries.
